name: Local Business Schema (JSON-LD) Lite
author: Lumiverse Dynamic

sections.description:
Local Business Schema Lite by Lumiverse

JSON-LD Local Business Schema

Easily add structured Local Business Schema (JSON-LD) to your website — improve your visibility on Google, attract more local customers, and enhance your search rankings. No coding needed. Fast, simple, and effective!

Features Available:
1. Business Type (4 Generic Types Available)
2. Business Name
3. Street Address
4. Image
5. City
6. State
7. AddressCountry
8. Postal Code
9. Phone
10. URL
11. Geo Coordinates
12. Google Map
13. Price Range

GO PRO
View our pro version, Localbusiness Schema PRO [JSON-LD]

Features Available:
1. Business Type (113+ business types)
2. Essential Business Details (Business Name, Street Address, City, State, Postal Code, Phone Number)
3. Second Address Support
4. Online Presence Information (Google Maps URL, Website URL)
5. Image to represent your business visually
6. List the payment methods
7. Add precise geographic coordinates to help search engines pinpoint your exact location.
8. Define your business’s operating hours
9. Specify your price range
10. Woocommerce Product Schema
11. Breadcrumbs Schema

sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins Page
  2. Add New
  3. Search “Local Business Schema by Lumiverse”
  4. Install & Activate
  5. Navigate to LB Schema JSON Tab in your admin menu and configure the plugin.
  6. Ready to go !
sections.faq:
Why JSON?

Because Google recommends using JSON-LD for structured data whenever possible.
